facts.fact: A UNDP Eswatini blog says that when its virtual remand work began in 2022 the judicial system was not digitised, with manual processes and traditional case management methods.

systems.system: Virtual remand pilot (Sidvwashini Remand Centre to Mbabane Magistrates Court)

SWZ.note: The UNDP Accelerator Lab is a donor unit, not a startup hub.
